title: SEC4: setContactBlocked missing error handling doc
description: Function setContactBlocked (lines 297-329) lacks clear documentation of error handling. JSDoc parameter describes contactId as 'tailscaleUserId' but function uses internal contact id field. Should clarify: (1) contactId is internal contact.id, not tailscaleUserId, (2) on server error, function shows banner and returns false (caller must handle). Also inconsistent with pattern used in other functions.
